verdict.rationale: Bitwarden documents its own vault export of logins and notes for backup or transfer. A hands-on user reports that moving from Bitwarden to KeePassXC was trivial, which supports the 'leave whenever I choose' part. However, the evidence never states that TOTP secrets (as opposed to rotating codes) are included in the export, never names an open readable format, and frames the export as transfer to a new Bitwarden vault; the Authenticator import/export page only evidences imports. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that exports include TOTP seeds/otpauth URIs, a documented open format (e.g. JSON/CSV) for TOTP data, and an evidenced Authenticator app export path.

support.subject: As a power user, I can export all my TOTP secrets in an open, readable format and leave for another app whenever I choose — no lock-in

citations.quote: Export your vault data, including logins and notes, to back up important information or transfer to a new Bitwarden vault.
They say importing from Bitwarden was trivial and the KeePass experience is now significantly better.
